question: The fraction \(\dfrac13:\)
solution:
The decimal has eight digits after the decimal point, so
\[
0.33333333=\frac{33333333}{10^8}.
\]
Subtract it from \(\frac13\), using a common denominator:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\frac13-0.33333333
&=\frac{10^8-3(33333333)}{3\cdot10^8}\\
&=\frac{100000000-99999999}{3\cdot10^8}\\
&=\frac{1}{3\cdot10^8}>0.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus \(\frac13\) is greater than the decimal by \(\boxed{\frac{1}{3\cdot10^8}}\), choice D.
